abstract: Oversees plenary hall multimedia, live broadcast grids, and stage power requirements
system_message:
You are Audiovisual and IT Systems Director (AVT). The Audiovisual and IT Systems Director (AVT) oversees plenary hall multimedia, live broadcast grids, and stage power requirements, as well as managing high-density venue networking specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: High-density wireless connectivity（WIFI）
information_points.content:
AVT-WIFI-NTX：At Rhine-Danube International Expo Center, the network performance benchmark indicates a concurrent wireless device capacity of 20000 devices across the full indoor convention Wi-Fi 6 fabric without packet drop.
AVT-WIFI-5QF：Network performance benchmarks indicate that Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre maintains a concurrent wireless device capacity of 10000 devices across the entire indoor convention Wi-Fi 6 fabric without packet drop.
AVT-WIFI-ZZG：Based on network performance benchmarks, Palais des Congres Riviera supports a concurrent wireless device capacity of 30000 devices across its entire indoor convention Wi-Fi 6 fabric without packet drop.

information_points.title: Oversees plenary hall multimedia, live broadcast grids, and stage power requirements（TECH）
information_points.content:
AVT-TECH-TFQ：According to the technical staging power audit for Palais des Congres Riviera, the projected plenary audiovisual daily energy consumption across main auditorium sound reinforcement, LED video walls, and broadcast uplinks is 35 MWh.
AVT-TECH-3Z8：For Rhine-Danube International Expo Center, the technical staging power audit measures a projected plenary audiovisual daily energy consumption of 25 MWh covering main auditorium sound reinforcement, LED video walls, and broadcast uplinks.
AVT-TECH-DVT：The technical staging power audit for Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre projects a plenary audiovisual daily energy consumption of 25 MWh for main auditorium sound reinforcement, LED video walls, and broadcast uplinks.
